🧠 GyanIQ

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

At GyanIQ ("we", "our", "the website"), protecting your privacy matters to us. This policy explains what data is collected when you use GyanIQ (gyaniq.in), why it's collected, and how it's protected.

1. What data we collect

WhenWhat's collected
Signing up / creating an accountEmail address, password (encrypted), name
After profile creationUsername (auto-generated or self-chosen)
Playing gamesScore, points, win/loss record, which games were played
Submitting a reviewUsername, rating, review text
Browsing the websitePage visits, device/browser type, approximate location (via Google Analytics)

2. How your password is stored

Your password is never stored in plain text. We use Supabase Authentication, which securely stores passwords using industry-standard encryption. Even our own team never sees your actual password.

3. How your data is used

  • To create your account and allow you to log in
  • To display leaderboards and rankings (only your username is shown publicly, never your email)
  • To improve the website — which games are played the most, what needs improving (via Google Analytics, using anonymous/aggregate data)
  • If you've left a review, to display it on the homepage/help page

4. Who we share data with

We do not sell or share your personal data (email, password) with any third party. Data is processed through these services:

  • Supabase — secure database and authentication for your account and game data
  • Google Analytics — anonymous website-traffic analysis (does not identify individual users)

5. What's publicly visible

Only your username, points/score and reviews (if submitted) may appear publicly on the leaderboard or homepage. Your email address, real name, or password are never displayed publicly.

6. Cookies and Local Storage

GyanIQ uses your browser's localStorage so you don't have to log in repeatedly (to remember your login session). Beyond this, we don't use tracking cookies other than standard Google Analytics tracking.

7. Your rights

  • The right to view your account data
  • The right to request deletion of your account and data — let us know via the Contact page
  • The right to reset your password at any time (here)

8. Children's Privacy

GyanIQ builds educational games that students can use, but you must be 13 years or older to create an account. If you believe a child has created an account without parental permission, please contact us.

9. Changes to this policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any major changes will be reflected by updating the "Last updated" date on this page.

10. Contact

For any privacy-related questions, please reach out through our Contact page.
